name: dsh-deepseek-provider
description: DSH plugin (dual-half): ships a Web GUI balance pill (conversation.composer.dock) for the built-in deepseek provider route — account balance per currency (total / granted / topped-up) fetched from GET {baseUrl}/user/balance at api.deepseek.com, with the API key resolved via the DSH credential seam. No provider seeding: the llm-pi-ai catalog already ships the deepseek route.
